spec.name: sprint33_taker_imbalance_15m_majors
spec.hypothesis: 5-minute aggressive taker buy/sell volume imbalance predicts 15-minute forward continuation in BTCUSD/ETHUSD; distinct signal family from the falsified price-pattern (meanrev/breakout) sprints, tested on liquid majors to isolate signal quality from the altbasket liquidity-cost confound seen in sprint31/32.
spec.power_argument: 2 symbols x ~8 qualifying |imbalance|>0.3 events/day x ~20-day sample >= 300 trades; at realized net-return sd ~35bps (per sprint31/32 magnitude), n=320 detects ~4bps min edge at power=0.8, alpha=0.05 -- well below the 25-34bps cost drag that killed the altbasket tests, so a real edge should survive if present
